quotations.text: For all 17 languages, average mean reading speed was 1.42 ± 0.13 texts/min (±SD), 184 ± 29 words/min, 370 ± 80 syllables/min, and 863 ± 234 characters/min.
Our analysis focussed on words per minute.
in our current study we assessed all reading speeds in four different ways: texts/min, words/min, syllables/min, and characters (without spaces and punctuation marks)/min.
The different languages are characterized differently depending on the unit used.

quotations.where: Methods, Procedure for Establishing Normal Reading Speeds
quotations.text: The texts were printed in the same format as described above for the pilot study and were read aloud at a distance of 40 cm. A stopwatch was used to measure reading time.
which confirms that reading aloud does not increase after the age of 15 to 18 years (due to speech rate ceiling).

quotations.where: Methods, Development of the Texts: The Linguistic Work
quotations.text: Ten paragraphs of German text were designed by a linguist from material for sixth grade reading (age 10–12 years) with a mean length of 132 words (SD ± 3.2). They were matched for difficulty and linguistic/syntactic complexity according to the theory of Gibson.
